source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project, IFAD-funded - "បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះក្រូចថ្លុងដែលធន់ទៅនឹងការប្រែប្រួលអាកាសធាតុ / Climate Resilience Pomelo Growing Technique", Nov 2018, 17pp
text: The guide includes a seasonal growing calendar (ប្រតិទិនដាំដុះ) laying out when major orchard activities - land preparation, weeding, fertilizing, pest and disease control, and harvest - typically fall across the year, giving farmers a planning reference so that labor and input needs can be anticipated rather than addressed only after a problem appears.
